ground: AQR data library (s51 next-ground (a)); AQR sitemap population

legitimacy.robots: www.aqr.com/robots.txt = 302 -> homepage HTML (soft-404). Under RFC 9309 an unavailable robots is ALLOW-ALL. Confirms s51.
legitimacy.licence: Public unauthenticated download. AQR asks only for citation 'AQR Capital Management, LLC.'. No auth wall, no paywall, no control circumvented.

population_correction.s51_claim: AQR front page is not factor ground; the factor library 'is elsewhere on the host and was not located this session'
population_correction.note: s51 saw 11 article URLs from the collector's landing page. The sitemap exposes 916. The collector's one-hop view understated the reachable population by ~83x.

finding_stated_lag_is_boilerplate.aqr_statement: 'We aim to update each data set monthly with a lag of about two months.'
finding_stated_lag_is_boilerplate.verdict: The stated lag is boilerplate on both datasets, understating actual staleness 1.6x and 3.1x. Per-dataset max(observation_date) is the only liveness measure.

finding_restatement_measured.claim_source: AQR about page: updated series 'highly (but not perfectly) correlated' with the original; entire history restated each update
finding_restatement_measured.method: Original-paper vintage vs current updated file, name-matched (NOT position-matched), identical 300-month overlap 1985-01..2009-12
finding_restatement_measured.verdict: Restatement is REAL but SMALL. Worst leg is commodities (corr 0.9312 => ~13% of variance over a FIXED historical window is vintage artifact). Sharpe shifts <=0.051 on every leg.
finding_restatement_measured.consequence: Sound as an ex-post benchmark. NOT a point-in-time series: the vintage downloaded today is not the vintage that existed at any past date, so it must never enter a live or PIT signal path.

trap_column_order.detail: Updated file column order is TSMOM,CM,EQ,FI,FX; original-paper file is TSMOM,EQ,FX,FI,CM.
trap_column_order.consequence: A positional merge of the two vintages silently swaps asset classes — FX would be read as CM. Match by header name.
trap_column_order.status: avoided in this session's measurement; recorded so no future reader repeats it

desk_gap_confirmed.evidence: desks/mt5/mt5desk/independence.py measures k_eff strictly from the desk's OWN sleeve ledger (daily_returns -> mean_pairwise_corr -> effective_bets). grep finds no external factor benchmark anywhere in libs/, scripts/, desks/.
desk_gap_confirmed.why_it_matters: A sleeve can be perfectly uncorrelated with every other DESK sleeve and still be a repackaging of a free, public, century-old factor premium (Currencies Carry). Internal-only independence cannot see this by construction. L1.61 requires selection to optimise MARGINAL independence.
desk_gap_confirmed.proposed_use: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — regress a candidate's backtest monthly returns on the matching AQR asset-class legs (FX sleeves -> Currencies V/M/C; metals+energy -> Commodities V/M/C; indices -> Equity indices V/M/C/D) and report residual alpha alongside the existing verdict.
desk_gap_confirmed.explicitly_not_a_gate: L1.60 forbids inserted gates. This is proposed with NO pass/fail path, mirroring wq_operators.fitness() which this seat's own brief cites as the precedent. Do not add a threshold.

feasibility_limit_stated.constraint: AQR legs are MONTHLY. A 14-day forward window yields 0 monthly observations, so this diagnostic can NEVER apply to a forward-window decision.
feasibility_limit_stated.applicable_where: Backtest histories only (a 2015-2026 candidate gives ~130 monthly observations, which is sufficient).

counts.note: No AQR Sharpe, threshold or fitness bar was imported as a desk gate (L1.6). Their numbers are recorded as facts about their process.
